item.title: Harbour cranes go quiet as the night shift ends
item.dc:creator: R. de Vries
item.description: The last container came off the deck just after five.
item.content:encoded: The last container came off the deck just after five. What follows is the hour nobody photographs, when the terminal belongs to the gulls.
